top_choice_rationale: The magic-wavelength optical lattice clock is a distinct idea from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion control prizes: a concept (Katori), a working instrument driven to the 1e-18 level (Ye), and independent national laboratories reproducing that performance. That is the concept, instrument, reproduction pattern I would require of a new microscope principle, and the two-name credit is clean. The citation should name the magic-wavelength lattice and the 1e-18 level, not timekeeping in general or the redefinition of the second. The overlap with earlier metrology prizes is a real but answerable reservation, so I prefer an award to no award.
